verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say it has built-in search and download via Hugging Face, plus a CLI `lms get` command and in-app download-and-run of local LLMs. A hands-on community user confirms you can search Hugging Face in the app and the model downloads and just works. missing for 10: coverage of the full Hugging Face catalog (a community report says some models aren't listed, with no explanation), and in-depth first-party docs on which model formats are supported.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: Download and run local LLMs like gpt-oss or Llama, Qwen
just search for the LLM off huggingface and it downloads and just works
